We use engine analysis to support the lessons, but the focus is on the explanation.

## Start with The Doubling Cube.  More lesson topics are coming.

The full Learn section will grow beyond the cube to include:

| Track | What you will learn |
|---|---|
| **Start Here** | How to read the board, follow lesson positions, and understand common terms |
| **Checker Play** | Racing, safety, flexibility, timing, contact, and tactical choices |
| **Opening Play** | Early moves, replies, and how game plans begin |
| **Match Play** | How the score changes checker and cube decisions |
| **Endgames** | Bearoffs, wastage, racing, timing, and practical counting |
| **Engines and Analysis** | How to understand evaluations, equity, error rates, and rollouts |

Beginners will be able to follow each path from the start. More experienced players can move directly to the questions they want to study.
